name: determinant
description: A human-auditable deterministic boundary between probabilistic AI and executable software.

scripts.compile:example: npm run build && node bin/determinant.mjs examples/order.aal --binding bindings/order.binding.json --out generated/order.ts
scripts.compile:example:zh: npm run build && node bin/determinant.mjs examples/order.zh-CN.aal --language zh-CN --binding bindings/order.binding.zh-CN.json --out generated/order.zh-CN.ts
